title: Hotaru no Yomeiri: Choitashi

thread.title: Firefly Wedding • Hotaru no Yomeiri - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Community reactions were strongly favorable toward the evolving chemistry between Satoko and Shinpei, especially their growing trust, teasing, jealousy, and ability to challenge one another.
Many viewers found the episode emotionally effective and appreciated its exploration of both characters' loneliness and desire for freedom.
The episode's humor was frequently praised, particularly the contrast between Shinpei's frightening behavior and Satoko's increasingly blunt, unfazed responses.
Several commenters liked the apparent escape opportunity but considered it suspiciously convenient and expected complications.
Some reactions were unfavorable toward the hostile women introduced near the end, viewing them as irritating antagonists.

notes: The thread clearly identifies Firefly Wedding/Hotaru no Yomeiri and episode 4, with no season mismatch.
